---
title: "Inline code, no theme"
filters:
  - code-window
highlight-style: none
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

The document below turns syntax highlighting off, so the theme gives no
background colour.

The filter then boxes the inline code with a colour it mixes from the page,
and that box has to compile too.

A paragraph with `inline code` in it.
